chunks.text: Standard per-acre fertiliser (products) for rice, by crop duration. Short duration (95-115 days): basal dose 22-24 kg DAP, 5-8 kg Urea, 20-23 kg MOP (muriate of potash) and 10 kg Zinc sulphate; 25-30 kg Urea at active tillering stage; 25-30 kg Urea at panicle initiation stage. Medium duration (120-135 days): basal dose 20-25 kg DAP, 15-17 kg Urea, 16 kg MOP and 10 kg Zinc sulphate (21%); 25-30 kg DAP at active tillering stage; 25-30 kg DAP at panicle initiation stage. Long duration (140-160 days): basal dose 28-30 kg DAP, 15-17 kg Urea, 16-18 kg MOP and 10 kg zinc sulphate; 30-32 kg Urea at active tillering stage; 30-32 kg Urea and 16-18 kg MOP at panicle initiation stage. Use the schedule for your variety's duration; one hectare is about 2.47 acres.

Duration-wise fertilizer and nutrient advisory for rice. Short duration varieties (95-115 days). Recommended fertilizer per acre (one acre): basal dose — 22-24 kg DAP, 5-8 kg Urea, 20-23 kg MOP (muriate of potash) and 10 kg Zinc sulphate; active tillering stage — 25-30 kg Urea; panicle initiation stage — 25-30 kg Urea.
